name: Amorites The
overview: The Amorites were a powerful, idolatrous people who once controlled extensive territory east of the Jordan River, including lands taken from Moab (Numbers 21:26). They opposed Israel’s peaceful request to pass through their land, leading to conflict in which Israel, by God's providence, defeated King Sihon and took possession of their cities and territory (Numbers 21:21-25). This defeat reflects God's judgment on the Amorites and His faithfulness in granting Israel victory over strong and hostile nations.
